safety.title: Date with clarity and confidence
safety.subtitle: Review Amor's community rules, learn how reports work and manage your privacy consent anytime.

rules.title: Community rules
rules.realProfile: Use your real identity and photos that represent you honestly.
rules.respect: Respect boundaries, identities and personal decisions.
rules.consent: Consent matters in every conversation and every meeting.
rules.noSpam: No harassment, spam, threats, scams or explicit pressure.

reporting.title: How reporting works
reporting.copy: Reports help Amor review unsafe or suspicious behavior. Blocking and reporting are separate controls, so you can immediately stop contact and still send a case for review.
reporting.stepOne: Choose a reason from the conversation menu.
reporting.stepTwo: Amor stores the report for moderation review.
reporting.stepThree: Moderators can review, dismiss or take action.

privacy.title: Privacy and consent
privacy.copy: Your required consent, optional analytics and personalization choices can be changed from the privacy page.

help.title: Need a safer next step?
help.copy: Open a conversation menu to block, report or remove a match. If something feels urgent, step away and use local emergency or support services.

actions.title: Know what each action does
actions.subtitle: These controls are designed to help you slow down, stop contact and send serious issues for review.

report.title: Report a user
report.copy: Use report when a profile, message or behavior feels unsafe, fake, abusive or suspicious.
report.reason: Choose the closest reason before sending the report.
report.review: The report is stored for admin or moderator review.
report.after: Reporting does not automatically keep the person from messaging you, so block them too if needed.

block.title: Block a user
block.copy: Blocking immediately pauses the conversation from your side and marks the match as blocked.
block.pause: The message input is disabled while the match is blocked.
block.visible: You can still see that the match exists, with a clear blocked state.
block.unblock: Use unblock if you decide to allow messages again.

tips.title: Dating safety tips
tips.publicMeet: Meet in a public place first.
tips.tellFriend: Tell someone you trust where you are going.
tips.noPressure: Leave any date or chat that feels pressuring.
tips.money: Never send money or sensitive codes to a match.

emergency.title: Emergency or immediate danger
emergency.copy: If you feel in immediate danger, leave the situation and contact local emergency services. Amor reports are not an emergency response channel.
